purpose: Identity-compatible action sprites for the four existing living ally roles, retaining their base and alternate gait appearances and cameras.
sourceTreatment: Original generated PNGs copied byte for byte. No pixel editing, no runtime masking, no costume/camera changes to old gait sources. Cuts derived from source connected alpha components and tested for full alpha > 8 coverage, zero foreign silhouette alpha and no touched source boundary.

sources.prompt:
Create one ORIGINAL DEADWALL game action sprite atlas, exactly 1536x1024 pixels. True alpha transparent background, no background/checkerboard/floor/labels/text/borders. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows = SIXTEEN isolated full-body sprites, one per 384x256 cell with broad transparent margins. Not a montage of overlapping figures. Each figure entirely inside its cell including tool and hands. All face toward screen RIGHT. Serious semi-realistic earthy game art, healthy living human allies. There are TWO appearances. ROWS 1–2 (cells 1–8 row-major) are appearance A; ROWS 3–4 (cells 9–16) are appearance B. Each sequence has EIGHT chronological distinct action frames, with both feet staying planted at the SAME location relative to each cell through the sequence. NO walking or running strides. Same person, sex, clothes, hairstyle, camera perspective and physical scale as the specified reference row; ONLY body action changes. No perspective or costume drift. Do not accidentally use any zombie row from the references. Avoid flames and large painted effects. Preserve each individual's original camera: some source individuals are OVERHEAD while some are SIDE/three-quarter, these differences must remain. Bodies need fit in 200px height, props can extend right up to 285px width but keep at least 32px cell gutter.
Appearance A = EXACT worker in image 1 SECOND ROW: living brown-haired man in mustard/brown padded jacket, olive trousers, brown backpack, boots, ORIGINAL OVERHEAD top-down camera showing mostly head-top/shoulders/back. No rifle. Appearance B = EXACT worker in image 2 THIRD ROW: living worker with dark hair under black knit beanie, orange work coveralls, gray work gloves, tool belt, boots, ORIGINAL SIDE three-quarter camera. Neither is a soldier or hardhat engineer. ACTION = BUILD with ordinary small steel hammer in right hand and a small wooden plank held near waist in left hand. Eight successive poses: rest-hammer-low; raise-forearm; hammer-up; downswing; contact-forward-low; follow-through; recover-halfway; rest-return. No separate building in cell, just individual and small hand-held plank. Preserve the camera distinction A overhead / B side.
CRITICAL OUTPUT VALIDITY: there must be NO drawn checker pattern, NO gray/white tiles, NO colored or gradient background. Everything outside the actual 16 human/tool silhouettes must be ZERO-ALPHA TRANSPARENT pixels. The transparent preview is supplied by the viewer, not painted onto the PNG. Work on blank alpha canvas. Make the humans smaller: maximal full silhouette height 180px per 256px row with 38px empty top/bottom space. Bottom row MUST retain at least 32px transparent margin below both boots, all feet and hammer tips complete. Exactly 4 columns × 4 rows, centered in each cell, do NOT expand figure beyond its cell.

references.description: Brown-haired living worker; mustard padded jacket, olive trousers, brown backpack.
Living worker; orange coveralls, black knit beanie, gray gloves, tool belt.
